minimal_v3_release_path.feasible: YES, one new candidate generation plus one root static release and independent peer review; no need to redesign four phase scanner.
required_change: Keep G290 raw receipt hardcoded and unchanged; freeze v3 INPUTS, common.py and scan_phase.py hashes and a fresh output directory.

Create a root static-release body that independently pins G290 receipt SHA, exact APK SHA/bytes/package, v3 INPUTS SHA, unchanged common/scan_phase hashes, four-phase-only scope, one attempt and outer/phase time limits; do not make it depend on v3 run.py SHA if v3 will embed its receipt SHA, to avoid a hash cycle.

In v3 runner, replace None sentinel with hardcoded release receipt path/SHA/schema/decision and verify actual receipt bytes and fields before any output. Merely setting ROOT_STATIC_RELEASE_SHA256 to a non-None value is unsafe because v2 never uses it for a comparison.

Have independent peer diff v3 against v2, run local denial/negative fixtures and review the root release; then root outer release pins exact v3 runner SHA and launches once with watchdog. Retain no-replay/unknown receipt semantics.
minimal_v3_release_path.residual: Same-UID files are not cryptographic separation; for this bounded local static inventory rely on separately reviewed root release plus exact outer command, and do not export this pattern as device/graph authorization.

limits: GO is for prepared candidate only. This review performed no scanner phase, network call, device or container action.
Packed KOM entries remain opaque and do not count as ELF or runtime loadability proof.
Even a future four-phase terminal candidate requires independent postrun and root review before static-complete count.
